description: Ex-Israeli Ouragan; airframe series 385; delivered to the FAS on 2 September 1975 and retired in the second half of the 1980s. Donated to the Dirección General de Aeronáutica Civil in 1989 and displayed beside the DGAC football pitch; since September 2018 it has stood in the plaza in front of the Civil Aviation accommodation block inside the Autoridad de Aviación Civil grounds. Photo credit El Diario de Hoy; 2018.

Built at Long Beach in June 1966 with 85 seats; flew for Swissair; then for the FAA and the JPATS programme; and was bought in June 2004 by Robinson Air Crane Inc. (now defunct) and ferried to El Salvador. Made its last landing at Ilopango on 11 November 2005 with 29;816 hours total time. Declared abandoned and became Salvadoran state property on 26 September 2017 under article 108 of the Ley Orgánica de Aviación Civil. Displayed on the AAC / ICCAE / COCESNA grounds at Ilopango.
